question: Is frozen State 2 actually one context-dependent state, or has the current abstraction collapsed multiple physically distinct topology aliases that can be discovered without child outcome labels and then tested against the already-frozen 2->1, 2->2 and 2->3 exits?

target.containmentDirection: smallest strictly larger wholly-containing frozen primary-depth observation -> contained frozen primary-depth observation
target.interpretation: anonymous physical alias candidate, not historical meaning and not causal proof

compatibility.topologyAtlasScope: all observations in the sealed blind input
compatibility.localStateScope: only observations eligible at the frozen local-state primary context-mass depth

allowedForLatentAliasDiscovery: State 2 parent endpoint and junction center proportions
State 2 parent PATH_TO_ENDPOINT, PATH_TO_JUNCTION and unresolved arm proportions by center kind
blind center-signature proportions derived from arm histograms
incoming topology delta from the previous coarser frozen containment observation when present
incoming containment geometry: area contraction, normalized center displacement and aspect-ratio change
physicalFeatureBoundary.reason: The alias breaker must ask whether State 2 contains physical substructure before any 2->1, 2->2 or 2->3 label can influence feature selection, k, centroids or assignments.

featureDiscovery.ranking: label-free train observation support, then raw variability, then deterministic feature name
featureDiscovery.standardization: train mean and standard deviation only

latentStateDiscovery.selection: highest deterministic sampled silhouette on train only; ties favor smaller k
latentStateDiscovery.stableAliasIds: lexicographic order of frozen train centroids after feature selection and standardization
latentStateDiscovery.transfer: holdout and control assigned to nearest frozen train centroid without refitting

exitReveal.threeWay: latent alias versus frozen child outcomes 1, 2 and 3
exitReveal.stageA: latent alias versus remain State 2 or exit State 2
exitReveal.stageB: conditional on exit, latent alias versus State 1 or State 3

nullModel.evaluation: after latent aliases freeze, shuffle child-state outcomes within lane + parent proposal scale + deterministic area-contraction quartile
preserves: child outcome inventory inside each stratum

theoryTargets.aliasHypothesis: State 2 contains two or more recurrent raw-topology aliases that can be discovered without observing their child-state outcomes.
theoryTargets.singleStateFalsifier: If no stable label-free aliases exist, or frozen train aliases carry no transferable exit information beyond the stratified null, retain State 2 as one context-dependent state at this resolution.
theoryTargets.twoStageOperatorTest: Report stay-versus-exit separately from State-1-versus-State-3 among exits so a sequential operator can surface without forcing a three-way classifier.
